narrative.overview: Ward looks like an instrument panel for chain-of-custody, not a marketing site that happens to have a dashboard. The field is near-black, panels are slightly raised sheets of the same darkness, and one-pixel hairlines do the work that shadows would do elsewhere. White carries action and headings; a single green behaves like a status lamp. Everything that came from an API, a file, or a rule engine is set in mono and labeled with its evidence state.
keyCharacteristics: One white primary action and one green signal
A fixed four-hue evidence taxonomy: blue verified, purple inferred, emerald owner-confirmed, amber unavailable
Mono for machine-produced values, sans for human prose
Full-bleed dashed rails on marketing and auth surfaces

rules.name: The Signal-Only Green Rule
rules.body: Emerald appears on live dots, confirmed evidence, and positive empty states; it never fills a primary button, a hero background, or a decorative gradient.

rules.name: The Four-State Hue Rule
rules.body: Blue is verified, purple is inferred, emerald is owner-confirmed, and amber is unavailable. The assignments are semantic and permanent.

rules.name: The Mono Attribution Rule
rules.body: If a value came from an API, a file path, a rule ID, a scan, or a credential variable, set it in Geist Mono. Human prose stays in Geist Sans.

rules.name: The Quiet Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type stops at 60px. Inside the product shell, headings stop at 24px. Hierarchy comes from spacing and weight, not size.

rules.name: The Showroom Guardrail
rules.body: The landing and auth screens may borrow SaasCN composition, but never evidence hues as decoration; the console never imports marketing chrome.

dos: Do pair every finding with its evidence state and a recommended human action in the same card.
Do use the fixed evidence hues and keep edge styles matched to them.
Do lead the landing page with a real artifact: a graph or an evidence record.
Do keep the landing to five content sections after the hero with one job each.
donts: Don't introduce gradient hero washes, floating 3D shapes, or purple-to-pink SaaS blur.
Don't fill a primary button with emerald, purple, or blue.
Don't recolor an evidence state for visual balance or reuse a taxonomy hue as decoration.
Don't import template filler: customer counts, company logos, testimonials, or adoption metrics.
Don't center the landing in a narrow column with 100px+ gutters.
